story.text: 며칠째 콧물과 기침이 멈추지 않았다. 목소리마저 갈라진 나를 보고 선우의 표정이 심각해졌다.
story.reading: myeo-chil-jjae kon-mul-gwa gi-chim-i meom-chu-ji anh-at-da. mok-so-ri-ma-jeo gal-la-jin na-reul bo-go seon-u-ui pyo-jeong-i sim-gak-hae-jyeot-da.
story.en: For days, my runny nose and cough wouldn't stop. Seeing my voice go hoarse too, Sunwoo's expression turned serious.

story.text: "이 정도면 그냥 넘길 증상이 아니다. 당장 병원 가자." 그가 반강제로 나를 끌고 나왔다.
story.reading: "i jeong-do-myeon geu-nyang neom-gil jeung-sang-i a-ni-da. dang-jang byeong-won ga-ja." geu-ga ban-gang-je-ro na-reul kkeul-go na-wat-da.
story.en: "This isn't a symptom you can just brush off anymore. We're going to the hospital right now." He half-dragged me out.

story.text: 근처 내과에 도착해 접수를 하고 얼마 기다리지 않아 진료를 받을 수 있었다. 선우는 대기실 의자에서 다리를 떨며 안절부절못했다.
story.reading: geun-cheo nae-gwa-e do-chak-hae jeop-su-reul ha-go eol-ma gi-da-ri-ji anh-a jin-ryo-reul bad-eul su iss-eot-da. seon-u-neun dae-gi-sil ui-ja-e-seo da-ri-reul tteol-myeo an-jeol-bu-jeol-mot-haet-da.
story.en: We arrived at a nearby internal medicine clinic, checked in, and it wasn't long before I could see the doctor. Sunwoo sat in the waiting room, jiggling his leg, unable to sit still.

story.text: 의사 선생님은 몇 가지를 묻고는 처방전을 건넸다. "감기몸살이네요, 며칠 푹 쉬셔야 해요."
story.reading: ui-sa seon-saeng-nim-eun myeot ga-ji-reul mut-go-neun cheo-bang-jeon-eul geon-net-da. "gam-gi-mom-sal-i-ne-yo, myeo-chil puk swi-syeo-ya hae-yo."
story.en: The doctor asked a few questions and then handed me a prescription. "It's a cold with body aches. You need to rest well for a few days."

story.text: 약국에 들러 약을 받는데, 선우가 대신 약사님께 이것저것 캐물었다. "이거 부작용 같은 거 없어요?"
story.reading: yak-guk-e deul-leo yak-eul bad-neun-de, seon-u-ga dae-sin yak-sa-nim-kke i-geot-jeo-geot kae-mul-eot-da. "i-geo bu-jak-yong gat-eun geo eop-seo-yo?"
story.en: Stopping by the pharmacy to get the medicine, Sunwoo peppered the pharmacist with questions on my behalf. "Does this have any side effects or anything?"

story.text: "이 약은 식후 삼십 분에 드세요." 약사님 말에 그는 나보다 더 진지하게 고개를 끄덕였다.
story.reading: "i yag-eun sik-hu sam-sip bun-e deu-se-yo." yak-sa-nim mal-e geu-neun na-bo-da deo jin-ji-ha-ge go-gae-reul kkeu-deok-yeot-da.
story.en: "Take this medicine thirty minutes after meals." At the pharmacist's words, he nodded even more seriously than I did.

story.text: "자, 이제 집에 가서 푹 쉬어라. 오늘은 내가 죽이라도 사다 줄게." 그가 봉지를 흔들며 앞장섰다.
story.reading: "ja, i-je jib-e ga-seo puk swi-eo-ra. o-neul-eun nae-ga juk-i-ra-do sa-da jul-ge." geu-ga bong-ji-reul heun-deul-myeo ap-jang-seot-da.
story.en: "Alright, go home and rest well now. I'll bring you some porridge or something today." He said, swinging the bag as he walked ahead.

story.text: "오늘 배운 단어랑 대화, 아프더라도 끝까지 챙겨봐라이."
story.reading: "o-neul bae-un dan-eo-rang dae-hwa, a-peu-deo-ra-do kkeut-kka-ji chaeng-gyeo-bwa-ra-i."
story.en: "Even if you're sick, get through today's words and conversation to the end."

words.example_en: My cold symptoms got worse, so I went to the hospital.
I got a prescription from the doctor and went to the pharmacy.

words.meaning: to receive medical treatment, see a doctor
words.example_en: I went to see a doctor early in the morning.
This medicine has almost no side effects.
This medicine should be taken after meals.

sentences.ko: 어제부터 목이 아프고 기침 증상이 있다.
sentences.reading: eo-je-bu-teo mog-i a-peu-go gi-chim jeung-sang-i it-da
sentences.en: I've had a sore throat and cough symptoms since yesterday.
The doctor wrote me a prescription.

sentences.ko: 아침 일찍 병원에 가서 진료를 받았다.
sentences.reading: a-chim il-jjik byeong-won-e ga-seo jin-ryo-reul bad-at-da
sentences.en: I went to the hospital early in the morning and saw a doctor.

sentences.ko: 이 약은 부작용이 거의 없다고 한다.
sentences.reading: i yag-eun bu-jak-yong-i geo-ui eop-da-go han-da
sentences.en: They say this medicine has almost no side effects.

sentences.reading: i yag-eun sik-hu sam-sip bun-e meog-eo-ya han-da
sentences.en: This medicine must be taken 30 minutes after meals.

turns.speaker: 선우
turns.en: Are you okay? Your face looks half-gone, seriously.

turns.speaker: 승객
turns.text: 그냥 목만 좀 아픈 건데. 병원까지 안 와도 됐는데.
turns.reading: geu-nyang mok-man jom a-peun geon-de. byeong-won-kka-ji an wa-do dwaet-neun-de.
turns.en: It's just my throat that hurts a bit. You didn't have to come all the way to the hospital.

turns.speaker: 선우
turns.text: 증상 며칠째라며. 그거 방치하면 더 심해진다.
turns.reading: jeung-sang myeo-chil-jjae-ra-myeo. geu-geo bang-chi-ha-myeon deo sim-hae-jin-da.
turns.en: You said the symptoms have lasted for days already. If you leave it, it'll get worse.

dialogues.question: 선우가 승객을 병원에 데려간 이유는 무엇인가요?
dialogues.question_en: Why did Sunwoo take the passenger to the hospital?
dialogues.correct_answer: 며칠째 이어진 증상을 방치하면 안 될 것 같아서
options: 며칠째 이어진 증상을 방치하면 안 될 것 같아서
dialogues.explanation: 선우는 며칠째 계속된 증상을 그냥 두면 더 심해질까 봐 승객을 병원에 데려갔습니다.

turns.speaker: 선우
turns.text: 이거 부작용 같은 거 없어요? 이 사람 원래 약을 좀 잘 못 먹는데.
turns.reading: i-geo bu-jak-yong gat-eun geo eop-seo-yo? i sa-ram won-lae yag-eul jom jal mot meong-neun-de.
turns.en: Does this have any side effects or anything? She's usually not great with medicine.

turns.speaker: 승객
turns.text: 야, 니가 왜 대신 물어보고 있노.
turns.reading: ya, ni-ga wae dae-sin mul-eo-bo-go it-no.
turns.en: Hey, why are you asking on my behalf.

turns.speaker: 선우
turns.text: 니는 가만있어봐라. 이런 건 확실히 물어야 된다.
turns.reading: ni-neun ga-man-iss-eo-bwa-ra. i-reon geon hwak-sil-hi mul-eo-ya doen-da.
turns.en: Just stay put. You have to ask these things properly.

turns.speaker: 승객
turns.en: …Fine, fine. You're totally acting like my guardian.

dialogues.question: 약국에서 선우가 한 행동은 무엇인가요?
dialogues.question_en: What did Sunwoo do at the pharmacy?
dialogues.explanation: 선우는 승객을 대신해 약사에게 약의 부작용이 있는지 꼼꼼히 물어보았습니다.
